clauses.clause: The bidder must demonstrate at least three comparable projects completed within the previous five years.
Le soumissionnaire doit justifier d'au moins trois références comparables livrées au cours des cinq dernières années.
The bidder must demonstrate at least two comparable projects.
The bidder must provide professional liability insurance coverage of at least CHF 10,000,000.
The bidder must maintain professional liability insurance coverage of at least CHF 25 million.
Le soumissionnaire doit fournir une assurance responsabilité professionnelle d'un montant d'au moins 10 millions CHF.
The bidder must provide professional liability insurance coverage of CHF 10,000,000.
The bidder must provide professional liability insurance coverage appropriate to the contract size.
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 27001 information security certification at the submission deadline.
The bidder must hold a recognised quality management certification issued by an accredited body.
The bidder must prove an annual turnover of at least CHF 5,000,000.
Services must be delivered in French.
The bidder must employ a German-speaking project manager for this mandate.
The bidder should demonstrate substantial experience with comparable data platforms.
The bidder must have substantial experience with comparable security operations.
Bids must be submitted through the electronic procurement platform before the stated deadline.
The project manager must have at least five years of experience with comparable mandates.
